title: The Desk That Won’t Stay Up
description:
Something is wrong with the kiosk Pod. It starts, dies, starts, dies — CrashLoopBackOff forever.

The fault is already in-cluster (bad command, missing path, or a lying image tag). Use describe, logs, and edits — not guesswork from outside. When you leave, one Pod should be **Ready**.

**Meant for:** Pod debugging (describe / logs / edit).

problemStatement.brief: A CrashLoopBackOff Guestbook pod is already in-cluster — find the fault and leave one Ready pod.
